image_prompt.text: A dominant island landmass with cliffs and a silhouette readable from open water, pulling players toward it
Hidden coves and inlets tucked behind headlands and overgrowth for players who poke around
Walkable tracks threading each island from the shoreline inland
An open sea filling the space between landmasses - the First Sea region players cross

notes: The prompt asks for an exact replica of an existing Roblox game's region. Nothing downstream can check fidelity to an external reference, so this builds a generic sea-and-islands region in the same spirit.
Close call between Adventure and RPG - the source game is a combat-progression grind, but the prompt names only the region, so the exploration surface was taken as the subject.
